_readme: 15 seed found items. 'location' strings that start with cafe-1/cafe-2/cafe-3 match Strathbites location IDs so claims on them can be verified against Strathbites order history. 'postedBy' is the email of the staff member who logged the item.

items.title: Samsung Galaxy A54 phone
items.location: cafe-3 (Student Centre Cafeteria), table near the window
items.description: Samsung Galaxy A54, Awesome Violet (light purple) colour, clear silicone case with a sticker of a mountain on the back. Screen has a small crack in the top-left corner. Phone is locked and was at about 40% battery. Handed in by cafeteria cleaning staff at 13:20. Stored in the Security Office safe, shelf A.

items.title: HP EliteBook laptop charger
items.description: HP 65W laptop charger with blue-tip connector, black. The cable has white electrical tape wrapped near the brick and the initials 'J.K.' written on the tape in marker. Found plugged into socket 14 at the silent study area. Stored at Security Office, drawer 2.

items.title: Strathmore student ID card
items.description: Strathmore University student ID card in a red lanyard with a plastic holder. Holder also contains a matatu SACCO loyalty card. Name and admission number visible on card (withheld here for privacy; claimant must state them). Found by the cashier after the lunch rush. Stored at Security Office, documents tray.

items.title: Black JanSport backpack
items.description: Black JanSport SuperBreak backpack, front pocket zip pull replaced with a green paperclip. Contains a grey Strathmore hoodie, a Casio fx-991ES calculator, two exercise books labelled 'Data Structures' and a half-full 750ml water bottle. No wallet or ID inside. Stored in Security Office, large-items cabinet.

items.title: Toyota car key with blue keychain
items.location: Parking Lot B, near the exit barrier
items.description: Single Toyota remote-lock car key (two buttons, worn rubber), on a blue fabric keychain printed 'Nairobi Marathon 2025'. Also attached: a small brass house key and a supermarket loyalty tag. Found on the ground by the exit barrier during the evening patrol. Stored in Security Office key box, hook 7.

items.title: Navy blue Strathmore hoodie
items.description: Navy blue Strathmore University pullover hoodie, size L, white logo on the chest. Left sleeve has a faded paint stain and the drawstring is missing. Left on seat F12 after the Friday guest lecture. Stored in Security Office, clothing rack.

items.title: Apple AirPods Pro (2nd gen) case
items.location: cafe-2 (Business School Cafe), counter by the coffee machine
items.description: White AirPods Pro charging case with both earbuds inside. Case is in a black leather-look cover with a gold carabiner clip. Engraving on the case reads 'K.L.' Found by the barista at 08:40. Stored in Security Office safe, shelf A.

items.title: Brown leather wallet
items.description: Brown bi-fold leather wallet, stitching coming loose on one edge. Contains a national ID, an Equity bank card, a library card and a small amount of cash (counted and sealed in an envelope, amount recorded in the security log). Claimed and released after ID check.

items.title: Scientific calculator Casio fx-991EX
items.location: Library, Ground Floor group discussion room 3
items.description: Casio fx-991EX ClassWiz calculator, black, with slide-on hard cover. Name scratched off the back; a yellow highlighter mark on the cover. Battery working. Stored at Security Office, drawer 2.

items.title: Prescription glasses in red case
items.description: Black rectangular prescription glasses (Ray-Ban style frame) inside a hard red clamshell case from an optician in Westlands. A microfibre cloth is folded inside. Found on bench 2 of the outdoor seating at 16:05. Stored in Security Office, shelf B.

items.title: National ID card
items.description: Kenyan national ID card, handed to the reception desk by a visitor. Details withheld for privacy; the owner must present a second form of identification. Released to owner after verification by the Admin office.

items.title: Silver Hydro Flask water bottle
items.description: Silver 32oz Hydro Flask with a black straw lid. Dented at the bottom and covered with stickers: a Kenyan flag, 'Code. Sleep. Repeat.' and a Strathmore Blades sticker. Found after evening basketball training. Stored in Security Office, shelf B.

items.title: Set of three keys on red ring
items.description: Three keys on a red metal split ring: one Yale padlock key, one long mortice key and one small mailbox key. A plastic tag reads 'Hostel B-14'. Found under a desk in row 3 after the 10:00 class. Stored in Security Office key box, hook 3.

items.title: Beige trench coat
items.location: cafe-1 (Main Cafeteria), coat hooks by the entrance
items.description: Women's beige trench coat, size M, belt included, from Mr Price. A folded bus ticket and a black hair tie in the right pocket. Left on the coat hooks over the weekend. Stored in Security Office, clothing rack.

items.title: Kindle Paperwhite e-reader
items.description: Amazon Kindle Paperwhite (11th gen) in a forest green fabric cover. Lock screen shows a photo of a golden retriever. Device is password protected. Found at desk Q-27 at closing time. Stored in Security Office safe, shelf A.
